description:
The UAT release gate (#1162) is wired and fail-closed but DORMANT for one more release by the trusted-base model: origin/release still runs the pre-UAT readiness script. The NEXT release (N) runs the old gate and ships the new script to release; the gate ACTIVATES at release N+1. There is no committed _project/release-evidence/uat-gate-summary.json on develop today, so before the SECOND release from now an operator must run the 3-stage release-gate sweep, run make uat-gate-check STAGE1=.. STAGE2=.. STAGE3=.., and commit the resulting uat-gate-summary.json (green verdict, clean tree, source SHA an ancestor of the release head, <=21 days old) to develop. Otherwise validate-base (a required, no-bypass check on release) hard-blocks the N+1 release PR. Verified fail-closed end-to-end in the batch final validation.

STAGE 1 ATTEMPT 2026-08-24: release-gate-01-native-dataframe dry-run passed, then the actual run on PR #1867 head e70f2ff59 was capped at 7200s after 166 cell records while processing sqlite SF1. No completed matrix_summary.tsv, validator rollup, or stage report was produced; this is incomplete evidence and cannot advance the gate. Run root: /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_20260824_081349. Command log: /tmp/uat-release-gate-stage1-20260824.log.

CURRENT 2026-08-24: merged request-only smoke exposed the LakeSail endpoint-option registration defect; PR #1875 fixes it. Do not treat the managed release-gate chain as runnable until #1875 merges and a host sustains ClickHouse's measured 5.25 GiB request.
